profile.description: Saudi Aramco Base Oil Company - Luberef produces and sells base oils and various by-products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, India, South Africa, Egypt, Singapore, the United States, South Korea, Cyprus, and internationally. It offers various group I and group II base oils; and byproducts, such as asphalt, marine heavy fuel oil, slack wax, extract, and sulfur, as well as white products, including ultra-low sulfur diesel, naphtha, and drilling fluid. The company was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Jeddah, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Saudi Aramco Base Oil Company - Luberef is a subsidiary of Saudi Arabian Oil Company.

finsightsData.company_name: Saudi Aramco Base Oil Company JSC

finsights.brief: Holds more cash than debt on its balance sheet
Net income is expected to grow this year

summary: Luberef reported record H1 2026 net income of SAR 992M, up 113% YoY, with EBITDA rising 94% to SAR 1.184B on historic crack margins of SAR 2,732/ton.
Free cash flow surged 346% to SAR 1B; board approved SAR 4/share interim dividend as shares climbed 1.92% to $127.40 near 52-week highs.
Company maintained 2026 production guidance at 1.15M metric tons; Growth II expansion 73% complete, expected operational in H1 2027.
Management warned crack margins will normalize in H2 2026 from record levels as seasonal demand eases, though remaining above historical averages.
Final investment decision on Jazan Group III+ facility with Saudi Aramco expected H1 2027; CapEx guidance held at SAR 300-350M for 2026.
